description: Figure 2 (left plot) is a bar chart illustrating an ablation study result on the INSPIRED dataset by showing the metric Recall@10 for four method variants. The horizontal axis contains the category labels “Ours,” “-critiquing,” “-scoring,” and “-ranking,” arranged left to right in that order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Recall@10” with a linear scale spanning approximately 0.1 to 0.4, with tick marks at about 0.1 intervals. There are four single, solid-colored bars: “Ours” is orange at roughly 0.35, “-critiquing” is blue at roughly 0.30, “-scoring” is blue at roughly 0.18, and “-ranking” is blue at roughly 0.24. No legend is shown within the plot, the bars are not stacked or grouped beyond the single series, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis effects beyond the first bar being colored differently (orange) from the others (blue).
